1042.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] <= -3  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_ArmyPresentInHOD"] == true)

1043.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1043.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] <= -3  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_ArmyPresentInHOD"] == true)) == false

1044.speaker: Player_Romus
1044.text: "Is there anything else the Delegates want to bring up before today's session ends?"

1045.speaker: Narrator
1045.text: Adarfo looked up at me with barely constrained anger.

1046.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1046.text: "People are suffering under the monarchy, and you talk about decorum."

1047.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1047.text: "This was me being polite, *Your Majesty*. See where it got me."

1048.speaker: Narrator
1048.text: Adarfo whipped around and walked down the aisle towards the exit. The other members of the RPP followed suit.

1052.speaker: Narrator
1052.text: Manus Sazon was the last to leave. He hesitated in the doorway for a moment, a pained look on his face, before turning and following his colleagues out.

1055.speaker: Player_Romus
1055.text: "We will resume this conversation when the time comes for Wehlen to hand Zille back. For now, are there any other topics on the agenda?"

1060.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1060.text: "The kind of systemic transformation that Rizia needs will not happen overnight, it's true. But in the meantime, there are things we can do to make an immediate, tangible difference in people's lives."

1061.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1061.text: "If the monarchy wants to stay in power, it should use its decree powers to make real, tangible differences in people's lives."

1062.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1062.text: "The fact that you regard these simple measures as extreme makes me fear for a future under the RNC."

1064.speaker: Player_Romus
1064.text: "We will speak more about this. I am looking forward to working with the 'evolved' RPP."
1064.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] <= -3  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_ArmyPresentInHOD"] == true)) == false

1070.speaker: Daria de Rava
1070.text: "The RNC will think about your ideas as well, Mr. Sotelato."

1071.speaker: Daria de Rava
1071.text: "Very well. But I hope you will keep the recommendation regarding Zille in mind."

1072.speaker: Player_Romus
1072.text: "Thank you both for your opinions regarding Zille. Now, let's move on."

1073.speaker: Player_Romus
1073.text: "I don't have to sit here and tolerate this. I'm calling an end to today's session."

1075.speaker: Player_Romus
1075.text: "I cannot promise anything. But send me your proposals."

1078.speaker: Narrator
1078.text: I saw disbelieving looks on both Hugo and Daria's faces.

1083.speaker: Player_Romus
1083.text: "I didn't come here to listen to you two squabble over Zille. There are more important things to discuss."

1084.speaker: Manus Sazon
1084.text: "Agreed, Your Majesty. Ms. De Rava, let's shelve this conversation."

1085.speaker: Daria de Rava
1085.text: "One moment. Your Majesty, this is not only about Zille."

1086.speaker: Daria de Rava
1086.text: "You have already introduced centralization measures to the provinces. You must agree that Brenas, Cardesse-Montaklar and Valenqiris should answer to the Crown before anyone else."

1093.speaker: Daria de Rava
1093.text: "We will have the same decision to make when Pales is reconquered. Will the spoils of war go to Rizia as a whole, or will they enrich House Azaro?"

1094.speaker: Daria de Rava
1094.text: "Rizia's three royal houses have contributed so much to this kingdom, yet their internal conflicts have nearly torn us apart."

1095.speaker: Daria de Rava
1095.text: "The provinces command their own armies and police forces. Grant them too much power, and they might use it to defy the Crown."

1096.speaker: Manus Sazon
1096.text: "Nobody is going to defy the Crown. The bloodshed of 1926 or the War of Succession will never happen again."

1097.speaker: Manus Sazon
1097.text: "The provinces do answer to the Crown. The bloodshed of 1926 or the War of Succession will never happen again."

1098.speaker: Manus Sazon
1098.text: "And with the merging of House Toras and House Sazon, two of the three houses will be united anyway."

1102.speaker: Narrator
1102.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Speaker_Manus"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == false) == false)

1103.speaker: Manus Sazon
1103.text: "When Zille rejoins us -- to say nothing of Pales -- we will gain millions of new citizens. How do we make sure nobody is left behind?"

1107.speaker: Manus Sazon
1107.text: "When Zille rejoins us, we will gain millions of new citizens. How do we make sure nobody is left behind?"

1108.speaker: Player_Romus
1108.text: "The hand of God will bring us together. Our devotion to Wruhecism will unite and uplift us."

1114.speaker: Manus Sazon
1114.text: "Nobody is going to defy the Crown. The bloodshed of 1926 or the War of Succession will never happen again."

1115.speaker: Manus Sazon
1115.text: "The provinces do answer to the Crown. The bloodshed of 1926 or the War of Succession will never happen again."

1120.speaker: Player_Romus
1120.text: "This session has been a waste of time so far. What else is on the docket?"

1122.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1122.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true

1123.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1123.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true) == false

1124.speaker: Player_Romus
1124.text: "I am surprised to hear you of all people arguing on behalf of noble privilege."
1124.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Speaker_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == false)

1125.speaker: Manus Sazon
1125.text: "I'm not asking for special privileges as a Sazon. All I'm requesting is that our connection to Zille should be recognized."

1127.speaker: Daria de Rava
1127.text: "I am truly sorry, Your Majesty. Moving on..."

1130.speaker: Player_Romus
1130.text: "You are the head of parliament, Baroness de Rava. Stay out of Royal House politics."

1135.speaker: Daria de Rava
1135.text: "Our win in Operation Golden Shield provided a considerable boost to national unity. However, the war is still ongoing, and we must find ways to keep morale up."

1139.speaker: Daria de Rava
1139.text: "Our loss in Operation Golden Shield was a considerable blow to national unity. We must find ways to keep morale up."

1140.speaker: Daria de Rava
1140.text: "The news of the King's success with Zille has provided a considerable boost to national unity. But I believe more can be done."

1144.speaker: Daria de Rava
1144.text: "The prolonged delay of Zille's return has been a detriment to national unity. We must find ways to keep morale up."

1148.speaker: Narrator
1148.text: She cast a look at Adarfo.

1149.speaker: Daria de Rava
1149.text: "Especially in light of the forces that seek to divide us."

1153.speaker: Narrator
1153.text: She cast a look at Manus.

1154.speaker: Daria de Rava
1154.text: "The RNC has heard the calls for reform, whether from the streets or from within these very walls."

1155.speaker: Daria de Rava
1155.text: "But we are convinced this is not the right way forward."

1157.speaker: Daria de Rava
1157.text: "In recent years, it has become fashionable to promote democracy as a salve for all of society's ills."

1158.speaker: Daria de Rava
1158.text: "In the RNC's opinion, Rizia has exactly as much democracy as it needs. Our King may act on the public's demands if he so chooses, but he is not subservient to them."

1159.speaker: Daria de Rava
1159.text: "Demonstrators come and go. We should not betray the ideals of our forebears just because a handful of voices are yelling at us to do so."

1163.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1163.text: "A handful? You have no idea how large our movement is."

1164.speaker: Daria de Rava
1164.text: "Of course, all of Rizia will come together to celebrate Princess Vina's wedding."
1164.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true)

1171.speaker: Daria de Rava
1171.text: "And, with any luck, our reunion with Pales."

1177.speaker: Daria de Rava
1177.text: "But perhaps we should find a way to extend Her Highness' good fortune to all citizens. A show of royal largesse."

1178.speaker: Manus Sazon
1178.text: "It's more than just a handful, Ms. de Rava, and you know it."

1179.speaker: Daria de Rava
1179.text: "Big or small, this 'movement' is a mere hiccup compared to the centuries-long tradition of the monarchy."

1180.speaker: Daria de Rava
1180.text: "Normally the RNC does not recommend grandiose gestures. But in this case, I suggest we remind the dissenters how good life under the Rizian monarchy can be."

1182.speaker: Daria de Rava
1182.text: "We can use our windfall from the Aureus gas field to provide free fuel to every citizen."

1186.speaker: Daria de Rava
1186.text: "The RNC suggests a show of largesse. The kind of gesture only a proud monarchy is capable of."
1186.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false)

1187.speaker: Daria de Rava
1187.text: "Imagine if every Rizian household had a car provided to them by the Crown. Perhaps even with His Majesty's face painted on it."

1188.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1188.text: "I've said all I need to say, Your Majesty."

1192.speaker: Narrator
1192.text: After a few final formalities, the House of Delegates session disbanded.

1193.speaker: Narrator
1193.text: A look of disbelief was frozen on Daria's face.

1194.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1194.text: "Not just valuable -- crucial. We are the majority, after all."

1198.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1198.text: "It's especially galling that the actual work will be done by disenfranchised labor hands, while the de Ravas rake in the rewards."

1202.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1202.text: "It's especially galling that the actual work will be done by disenfranchised commoners while the de Ravas rake in the rewards."

1203.speaker: Daria de Rava
1203.text: "In times of strife, a grand gesture from the King may indeed boost national unity."

1204.speaker: Daria de Rava
1204.text: "But only if it comes as a gift from the monarch, not a sop to reformists."

1205.speaker: Narrator
1205.text: He looked at me with piercing eyes.

1209.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1209.text: "Unless the Grand Wiseman has anything to add."

1210.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1210.text: "I've said all I need to say, Your Majesty."

1211.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1211.text: "I have heard the people cry out for help, the same as you."

1213.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1213.text: "By God and the King's good graces, they shall be uplifted."

1214.speaker: Player_Romus
1214.text: "I can tell you're new to politics. Trust me when I say you'll get a lot further with honey than vinegar."

1215.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1215.text: "I will not apologize for filling my role as a conduit of public opinion."

1219.speaker: Player_Romus
1219.text: "I will be the judge of that."

1221.speaker: Player_Romus
1221.text: "But only if they are pure of heart and have not sinned."

1222.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1222.text: "Give it some thought. Before it's too late."

1225.speaker: Player_Romus
1225.text: "By uniting everyone under the banner of the Rizian monarchy, of course."

1229.speaker: Player_Romus
1229.text: "The state will provide for them, as we always have."

1230.speaker: Player_Romus
1230.text: "We won't have to worry about that. Rizia is paradise compared to Wehlen."

1237.speaker: Manus Sazon
1237.text: "Rizia is evolving, Your Majesty. We must have the courage to evolve with it."

1238.speaker: Manus Sazon
1238.text: "You have heard the growing call for reform. Perhaps you are even planning to respond in some way."

1239.speaker: Manus Sazon
1239.text: "You have heard the call for reform. With the RPP leading parliament, it is too loud to ignore."

1241.speaker: Manus Sazon
1241.text: "The sweeping changes that they demand will take time. But meanwhile, the Crown has the capability to make a real difference in commoners' lives."

1245.speaker: Manus Sazon
1245.text: "Rizia is wealthier than we ever were during the Valero era. We shouldn't be afraid to distribute our resources to the people who need them most."

1246.speaker: Manus Sazon
1246.text: "We're becoming a world leader in natural gas. We should share the profits with those who need them most."

1250.speaker: Manus Sazon
1250.text: "Now that RRG has been nationalized, all of Rizia should share in our gold mining profits."
1250.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_BudgetModifiersTotal"] > 7) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_RRG_StateOwns100"] == true)

1254.speaker: Manus Sazon
1254.text: "We may not have the resources to do so right at this moment. But if you'll permit me a flight of fancy..."
1254.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_BudgetModifiersTotal"] > 7) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_RRG_StateOwns100"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

1255.speaker: Manus Sazon
1255.text: "Rather than pour our resources into the invasion of Pales, we should be spending them on our people."
1255.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_BudgetModifiersTotal"] > 7) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_RRG_StateOwns100"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

1268.speaker: Manus Sazon
1268.text: "Our energy surplus is the envy of Merkopa. We could use it to cover electricity costs for every household in the country..."

1269.speaker: Manus Sazon
1269.text: "We are not asking for that. Only some measure of recognition."

1270.speaker: Manus Sazon
1270.text: "People on the streets are demanding affordable health care -- I agree that this will save our government millions in the long run."

1271.speaker: Manus Sazon
1271.text: "Our public transport is subsidized. Why shouldn't it be entirely free of charge?"

1272.speaker: Manus Sazon
1272.text: "If we subsidize public transit, we'll reduce car traffic and relieve commuters' economic stress in one fell swoop."

1273.speaker: Manus Sazon
1273.text: "Increasing funds for health care was a good first step, but why do Rizians have to pay for medical treatment at all?"

1274.speaker: Player_Romus
1274.text: "Why not go further? We could institute a monthly base wage that frees all Rizians from the fear of poverty."

1275.speaker: Player_Romus
1275.text: "What's next, a proposal that I personally wipe our citizens' bottoms when they visit the toilet?"

1279.speaker: Player_Romus
1279.text: "Very reasonable proposals. However, I worry implementing them all at once will put a strain our resources.”

1280.speaker: Player_Romus
1280.text: "Rizian living standards are better than ever before. I see no need to gild the lily."

1286.speaker: Manus Sazon
1286.text: "Rizians are willing to pay taxes for these services, Your Majesty. It was not our idea that they be removed."

1293.speaker: Manus Sazon
1293.text: "Rizians pay income tax, Your Majesty. They should see that money invested back into their communities."

1294.speaker: Player_Romus
1294.text: "Good thinking. That way, everyone will know how generous their king is."

1295.speaker: Player_Romus
1295.text: "You are asking for too much. Besides, handouts are no way to improve living standards."
1295.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Energy"] > 10) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Great"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Good"] == true) == false)

1296.speaker: Daria de Rava
1296.text: "The RNC strongly objects to such an idea, Your Majesty."

1300.speaker: Daria de Rava
1300.text: "The RNC strongly objects to such an idea, Your Majesty."

1302.speaker: Manus Sazon
1302.text: "Public approval of the Crown has continued to drop since the loss of Golden Shield. If you want to save face, such actions may be necessary."

1312.speaker: Manus Sazon
1312.text: "The Crown's public approval ratings are plummeting. If you want to save face, such actions may be necessary."
1312.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] < 0)

1313.speaker: Manus Sazon
1313.text: "The public is on your side. Actions such as these will buoy support for you even further."
1313.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_PublicOpinion"] < 0) == false)

1314.speaker: Player_Romus
1314.text: "Your words and your proposals will be taken into consideration."

1318.speaker: Player_Romus
1318.text: "What is the RNC's opinion, Baroness de Rava?"

1319.speaker: Daria de Rava
1319.text: "Your Majesty, we are of the opinion that Rizia does more than enough for its citizens."

1321.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1321.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] <= -3  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_ArmyPresentInHOD"] == true)

1322.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1322.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] <= -3  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_ArmyPresentInHOD"] == true)) == false

1323.speaker: Player_Romus
1323.text: "I have entertained your ramblings for long enough. I have an announcement to make." [Shut Down the House of Delegates]
1323.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] <= -3  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_ArmyPresentInHOD"] == true)

1328.speaker: Player_Romus
1328.text: "What do you make of all this, Grand Wiseman?"

1329.speaker: Narrator
1329.text: Sal cleared his throat a few times.

1330.speaker: Daria de Rava
1330.text: "Our opinion is that the welfare traditions of Queen Lyza were strong enough."

1331.speaker: Daria de Rava
1331.text: "Having said that, a one-time show of largesse from the Crown could provide a much-needed boost to national unity."

1333.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1333.text: "Your Majesty, it is the Crown's moral responsibility to provide for those who are most in need. "

1334.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1334.text: "But I do worry that some sense of compassion among the populace is lost when charity becomes the duty of the government and not the individual."

1335.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1335.text: "And to extend such measures to all citizens, regardless of religion, risks rewarding heathens and nonbelievers--"

1336.speaker: Manus Sazon
1336.text: "'Rewarding'? All Rizians have the right to a high quality of life, not only the Wruhecist faithful."

1340.speaker: Daria de Rava
1340.text: "A one-time show of largesse from the Crown could boost national unity, but we hardly need that."

1344.speaker: Daria de Rava
1344.text: "We're already putting on a royal wedding, after all."

1356.speaker: Narrator
1356.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true)

1357.speaker: Manus Sazon
1357.text: "In the end, Ms. de Rava, we cannot bribe our way into national unity. We can only achieve that by empowering our citizens."
1357.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false)

1358.speaker: Manus Sazon
1358.text: "Yes, that particular measure sounds too extreme to succeed. But if the Crown does pass such a decree, the RPP will support its implementation."

1360.speaker: Player_Romus
1360.text: "Rizia is changing, Mr. Sazon. You must accept that a closer connection to Wruhecism is what the public wants."
1360.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_Government_Absolutism"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.LeaningValue_Democratic"] <= -3  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn07_Intention_HODShutdown"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_ArmyPresentInHOD"] == true)) == false

1361.speaker: Player_Romus
1361.text: "Rizia is changing, Mr. Sazon. To that end, I have an announcement to make." [Shut Down the House of Delegates]

1401.text: "In addition to providing millions with reliable transportation, this would signal to the world that Rizia is looking towards the future -- when cars will no longer be luxuries, but necessities."

1403.speaker: Player_Romus
1403.text: "What does the leader of the RPP think about this idea?"

1407.text: "Well, Grand Wiseman Ignacius? Are automobiles the future?"

1413.text: "St. Wruhec walked far and wide to spread his knowledge to his disciples. Had a faster means of transport been available, I am sure he would have used it."

1414.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1414.text: "Aside from concerns about traffic and air pollution... I think we should ask ourselves who is making these 'free' cars, and whether this is really what they want."

1415.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1415.text: "The RNC is trying to put a gauze bandage on a gaping wound. It won't work."

1416.speaker: Manus Sazon
1416.text: "I think Rizia has a perfectly fine public transit system. I use it myself, in fact."

1417.speaker: Manus Sazon
1417.text: "If we have the means to do so, we should make public transportation free, not automobiles."

1421.speaker: Manus Sazon
1421.text: "I think we should fix our overcrowded public transportation system before we begin talking about cars and fuel."

1422.speaker: Manus Sazon
1422.text: "Creating more traffic and more pollution will only add to the existing problems in this country."

1423.speaker: Daria de Rava
1423.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I thought you might."

1424.speaker: Daria de Rava
1424.text: "That may be so. But cementing the loyalty of your people will be worth it."

1428.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1428.text: "What loyalty? Madam Speaker is trying to put a gauze bandage on a gaping wound."

1432.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1432.text: "You are both trying to put a gauze bandage on a gaping wound."

1433.speaker: Player_Romus
1433.text: "Automobiles are not the future, Madam Speaker. I would rather concentrate our resources on public transit."

1437.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1437.text: "Either way, you are putting a gauze bandage on a gaping wound."

1438.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1438.text: "We can see through the RNC's bribery schemes. You're going to have to try harder than that."

1439.speaker: Manus Sazon
1439.text: "As an avid user of public transportation myself, I agree."

1440.speaker: Manus Sazon
1440.text: "I would like to point out that if we put those same resources into public transit, we could move millions more people far more effectively."

1457.text: "Thank you for listening, anyway. Despite the RPP's naysaying."

1472.speaker: Player_Romus

1486.speaker: Hugo Toras

1492.speaker: Hugo Toras
1492.text: "Then again, Baroness de Rava's comments troubled me. I wouldn't want to see our royal houses diminish in importance."

1493.text: "Well, that's why we don't have to listen to the RNC's recommendations."

1494.speaker: Player_Romus
1494.text: "House Toras will always come first, Hugo. You worry too much."

1495.speaker: Player_Romus
1495.text: "With our police and armies centralized, it would be an empty gesture. Symbolic at most."

1499.speaker: Player_Romus
1499.text: "She was right. Rizia's provincial system is a relic of a bygone age."

1500.speaker: Player_Romus
1500.text: "With Zille under their command, the Sazons would be capable of raising quite a large army against us. We must keep that from happening at any cost."

1501.speaker: Player_Romus
1501.text: "She is trying to climb up the power ladder. Her family isn't even real nobility."

1502.speaker: Player_Romus
1502.text: "I don't even want to think about this until Zille is officially returned. Our humorous friend could still have a trick or two up his sleeve before then."

1506.speaker: Player_Romus
1506.text: "First, we get Zille back. Then we have this discussion."

1516.speaker: Player_Romus

1520.speaker: Player_Romus
1520.text: "If the reformists get their way, none of this will matter anyway."

1524.speaker: Hugo Toras
1524.text: "The provinces are the pillars that support our kingdom's weight. You must take great care before dismantling such a system."

1525.speaker: Hugo Toras
1525.text: "They have served the Crown well. More so than the Sazons, even. But still..."

1528.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1528.text: "This chamber, Your Majesty... it is nothing but a nuisance."

1529.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1529.text: "Who among these 'Delegates' is fit to advise the King of Rizia?"

1530.speaker: Narrator

1531.speaker: Player_Romus
1531.text: "What are you waiting for? You're all dismissed."

1532.speaker: Player_Romus
1532.text: "I am sorry about this unpleasantness. These lunatics are disgracing the good name of the House of Delegates."

1533.speaker: Player_Romus
1533.text: "This won't go on for much longer, I promise."

1534.speaker: Player_Romus
1534.text: "This is your fault. The RNC needs to recognize which way the wind is blowing and adapt accordingly."

1537.speaker: Daria de Rava
1537.text: "I will try to keep a handle on them, Your Majesty."

1538.speaker: Narrator
1538.text: She motioned to her party members, and they began heading towards the exit.

1539.speaker: Daria de Rava
1539.text: "I... yes, Your Majesty. We are sorry."

1540.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1540.text: "Even putting aside the level of disrespect we've just witnessed..."

1544.speaker: Player_Romus
1544.text: "Without a conduit to the people, I am unmoored as a ruler."

1548.text: "The religious leaders of Rizia speak to the populace every day. They're more suitable conduit than this lot."

1549.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1549.text: "The time may soon come when they are no longer needed."

1550.speaker: Player_Romus
1550.text: "You flatter me. But the House of Delegates is a necessary institution."

1551.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1551.text: "For now, perhaps... But a time may come when it is not needed.”

1601.speaker: Player_Romus
1601.text: "I will leave the decision to the House Speaker."

1635.text: "A messenger, Your Majesty. From your own populace."

1639.speaker: Player_Romus

1641.speaker: Player_Romus

1736.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
1736.text: "You already have control over this parliament, Your Majesty. That you would bring these *enforcers* here only serves as proof that you are scared of your own people."

1742.speaker: Player_Romus
1742.text: "Our men and women in uniform are here to keep anti-Crown fanatics like you from overstepping their bounds. They are staying."

1743.speaker: Player_Romus
